note: La Salle County, TX: Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found no zoning district layer for the county. Cotulla (the county seat and largest city) has a zoning chapter in its code (Chapter 58), but no queryable zoning district service or GIS map was found on its website or in searches. County map pages show precincts and roads only; parcel sites show zoning codes for about 1.5% of records only and are paywalled.
